If disabled, the render will open an actual Chrome window where you can see the render happen. This requires [Chrome for Testing](/docs/miscellaneous/chrome-headless-shell) or a custom Chrome or Chromium executable. Chrome Headless Shell always runs headlessly. The default is headless mode.

## CLI flag

Use `--disable-headless` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                         | Flag                 |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                           | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                           | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                             | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)               | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                     | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)                                 | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)             | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)               | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions) | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)         | `--disable-headless` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)           | `--disable-headless` |
